// CI-only deterministic execution port. Real sandbox transport is tested separately.
export function usePyodide(){
 const probe=window.__remedy;
 return {isReady:true,error:null,retry(){},cancel(){probe.cancels++;},async runPython(code,_capture,stdin,testCode){
  probe.pythonCalls.push({code,stdin,testCode});
  if(probe.pythonKind==='hang')return new Promise(resolve=>{probe.resolvePython=resolve;});
  if(probe.pythonKind==='error')throw Object.assign(new Error('AssertionError: expected zero'),{name:'PythonError',executionPhase:'tests',assertionFailure:true});
  if(probe.pythonKind==='environment')throw Object.assign(new Error('runtime unavailable'),{name:'RuntimeError'});
  return {output:'synthetic output',assertionsPassed:probe.pythonKind==='empty'?0:1};
 }};
}
